dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Guys, I'm putting together ideas for our Altai trip. Has anyone here been hiking before? I want to know everyone's experience level.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I've been hiking twice — once near Almaty with my family when I was twelve, and once last year at Burabay. Both times were amazing!

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: I've never gone proper hiking before. I've walked a lot in cities, but I've never slept in a tent or carried a heavy rucksack. Is it very difficult?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: It depends on the trail. Have you ever exercised a lot outdoors? Even running or cycling counts as preparation.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: I've played football twice a week for five years, so I think I'm fit enough. But I've never cooked on a campfire. Is that a skill we need?

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Yes! Have you ever tried making tea on a gas stove? It's much harder than it sounds. But Kamila's brilliant at camp cooking. She's already taught me once.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Ha! I've made lots of mistakes too. Once, I accidentally burned the rice completely. But I've learned from each mistake. The key is preparation.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I've been on five hiking trips. I've slept in a tent, crossed rivers, and once even got lost for two hours! But I've always found my way back.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: You've gotten LOST? That sounds terrifying! Has anything really dangerous ever happened on a trip?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Nothing too serious. I've twisted my ankle once, and Zhibek — haven't you seen a bear near the trail before?

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Not a bear! We heard strange sounds at night. I've never been so scared in my life! But it turned out to be a deer.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: OK I feel better now! So — Amir, you've never camped before, but you're fit. Rustam has the most experience. Zhibek has done it twice. And I've prepared the food list already. We're going to be fine.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Sounds perfect. I have to say — I've never looked forward to anything as much as this trip. Let's go to Altai!
